name: Morophon, the Boundless
oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
As Morophon enters, choose a creature type.
Spells of the chosen type you cast cost {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} less to cast. This effect reduces only the amount of colored mana you pay.
Other creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1.
blocked_sentences: Spells of the chosen type you cast cost {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} less to cast. This effect reduces only the amount of colored mana you pay.

needs.what: a spell_cost_reduction whose discount is a set of colored mana symbols ({W}{U}{B}{R}{G}) rather than a generic number: each listed symbol removes one matching colored pip from the spell's cost if present, never touching generic mana and never reducing a color the cost does not contain; affects_spells must accept subtypes [{"chosen_type_of": "self"}] as Herald's Horn already does
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The spell_cost_reduction static (player_statics.spell_cost_reduction and cost_reduction.cost_reduction) takes only an integer `amount` and is generic-only by design ('Generic only, and never below zero'); writing amount 5 would instead knock {5} off the generic part, which is a different and much stronger card (it would make Morophon's own deck's colorless/generic-heavy spells near free and not reduce colored pips at all). No cost_reduction_keys entry names colored symbols.
